description: This file is a CMake module script defining the function 'compile_aidl' used for generating source code from AIDL files during build time. It includes detailed comments, usage instructions, and the implementation of the function itself, which wraps around the aidl compiler invocation.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to compile AIDL files into source code using the specified aidl compiler, language, include directories, and output directory, with appropriate error handling and configuration.
